description: This file defines a JoyCursor class for joystick-based cursor navigation in a Kivy application, including methods for activation, movement, and interaction, as well as functions to create, start, and stop the JoyCursor.

classes.name: JoyCursor
classes.description: A widget that enables joystick-controlled cursor navigation and interaction within a Kivy application.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JoyCursor widget, sets up drawing and properties.

methods.name: on_window_children
methods.description: Ensures the cursor widget is brought to the front when added to the window.

methods.name: on_activated
methods.description: Handles activation and deactivation of the JoyCursor, binding/unbinding events.

methods.name: set_cursor
methods.description: Creates the cursor's graphical points based on current position and size.

methods.name: check_cursor
methods.description: Updates cursor offset based on joystick axis input.

methods.name: set_intensity
methods.description: Adjusts cursor movement intensity based on joystick button input.

methods.name: check_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches mouse events based on joystick button presses.

methods.name: move_cursor
methods.description: Moves the cursor based on current offsets.

methods.name: stop_cursor
methods.description: Pins the cursor to a specific mouse position.

methods.name: on_pos
methods.description: Updates cursor graphics when position changes.

methods.name: keyboard_shortcuts
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for toggling activation.

methods.name: joystick_shortcuts
methods.description: Handles joystick button shortcuts for toggling activation.
